title: As Beef Prices Remain High, Trump Calls for Inquiry Into Meatpackers
summary: The Justice Department has opened an investigation into possible collusion among the big meatpackers. The effort may mollify ranchers, but it’s unclear how far it will go.

title: As Trump Weighs Sale of Advanced A.I. Chips to China, Critics Sound Alarm
summary: The president signaled he would discuss the sale of Nvidia’s Blackwell chips in a summit on Thursday, a move U.S. officials warned would be a “massive” national security mistake.

title: Data Fog Intensifying for Fed as Shutdown Delays US Inflation Numbers
summary: Two monthly jobs reports have fallen victim to the longest US government shutdown and a key inflation snapshot due in the coming week is also in jeopardy, illustrating a thickening data fog for a Federal Reserve that’s the most divided in recent memory.
